documentation.content: Cloud Run is returning server errors (5xx). More than 5 in a 5-minute window triggers this alert. Check request logs for the failing endpoints and correlate with ERROR logs.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.label."service_name" = "matrimonial-backend" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.label."response_code_class" = "5xx"
